title: Fiji EInvoice Response Schema
description: JSON Schema for India E-Invoice Response JSON file format. Created by WTG as a schema was not supplied. See https://einv-apisandbox.nic.in/version1.00/generate-irn.html > Response Payload

AckDt.description: Date and time on which invoice is registered(Date format is ‘yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss ’).

Irn.description: SHA256 hash of Gstin, DocDtls.No, DocDtls.Typ, financial year of DoctDtls.Dt

SignedInvoice.description: Complete e-Invoice data digitally signed using JSON Web Token(JWT) and JSON Web Signature (JWS) with “SHA256RSA” algorithm

SignedQRCode.description: Complete QR- Code data digitally signed using JSON Web Token(JWT) and JSON Web Signature (JWS) with “SHA256RSA” algorithm
